title: Reading Drill — Sorting bricks for reuse — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Sorting bricks for reuse — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The site supervisor in Elmbrook received an old report about reusable bricks being mixed with cracked pieces. The report compared the proportion of intact bricks recovered, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the sample checks rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include mortar left on the bricks. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed sorting before transport as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
